priorEvidence: Issue #10 is reused as the existing local BSL/write task and was not rerun.
baseline: Standard direct filename/content search and source reads over the immutable split snapshot, without a mandatory navigation recipe or derived index.
candidate: The same tools and snapshot plus a bounded context-frontier protocol: bind identity, derive terms, log selected hits, attach rationale/locator/bytes/claim, expand only to required owners/callers/effects, run a sufficiency checklist, and stop.
hardGates: candidate coverage is not lower per task
all substantive claims have exact-snapshot locators
metadata native acceptance is at least as strong as baseline
stale, insufficient and same-term-distractor negatives fail closed
originalPositiveSignal: At least one oracle-essential relation found only by candidate, or at least one 25% reduction in context bytes, navigation operations, or wall clock under the original companion conditions.
preResultsAmendment: A reduction counts only with <=10% regression in every other observed efficiency metric; candidate-only essential coverage also requires <=10% regression. Signed reductions only. Designer load/update proves platform acceptance, not runtime semantics.
decisionRule: Keep the candidate only when all hard gates, the cost ceiling, and an amended positive branch pass. Otherwise retain direct source and add no component.
claimScope: One SDMS cross-object task, one Jet metadata task, and reused issue #10 evidence; no universal or statistical claim about 1C navigation.
